rationale: This repo's .gitignore covers .ll/ only as a list of individual entries (history.db, queue.db, *.lock, ll-context-state.json, ...), not the directory. Uncovered paths include .ll/decisions.d/ (282 tracked fragments), .ll/decisions.yaml, .ll/ll-config.json and .ll/loops/ — so a decision fragment or loop-suggestion written mid-run would read as an out-of-scope write by the loop. The .loops/ half is required for the same reason for the scratch-pad-redirect hook's .loops/tmp/scratch/<cmd>-<pid>.txt writes (subprocess_utils.py:292) in consuming projects that do not gitignore .loops/. Excluding .ll/ wholesale also makes FEAT-3332 requirement (p) (loops_dir out of the audited window) structurally true rather than merely temporally true. Precedent: general-task.yaml's final_verify_spin_gate already uses ':(exclude).loops/'.
rule: check_intent_scope excludes both .loops/ and .ll/ as whole directories via explicit ':(exclude)' pathspecs on both the init baseline and the gate's current-set capture, rather than relying on ambient gitignore.
alternatives_rejected: run_dir-relative exclusion only (rejected: fails on the scratch-pad hook's writes, which are outside run_dir and not the loop's doing). Relying on ambient gitignore (rejected: works in this repo by accident via .gitignore:88 and breaks in any consuming project without those entries). Excluding .loops/ only and documenting .ll/ writes as an accepted limit (rejected: it is a live false-positive source in this very repo, not a theoretical one).
